was: 82 sites (32 overnight + seasonals), 30-amp electric+water, gravel/cement back-in pads, big rigs OK; two ponds (fishing + swimming). Near Indian Lake. --Claude
note: Family-owned campground at 959 CR 111 E, Rushsylvania, nine miles north of Bellefontaine and 12 miles east of Indian Lake, open May 1 to October 25 in 2026: 82 sites, all with 30-amp electric and water, 32 of them for overnight stays and the rest seasonal, among them twelve gravel-and-cement back-in pads and grass buddy sites.  It has two ponds, one for swimming and catch-and-release fishing, a lodge with a general store, a shower house, a dump station, hiking trails, a dog run and a playground.  The entry gate is staffed and closes overnight, from 9 p.m. Sunday to Thursday and from 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday. --Claude

was: City of Rifle municipal park (NOT the adjacent Rifle Falls State Park) in a limestone canyon along East Rifle Creek, north of the fish hatchery. Primitive sites along the creek; mix of FCFS and online-reservable via RoverPass, with the 14 Huffman Gulch sites staying FCFS (some car-camping-only). $30/night incl. day pass ($20 with annual pass); pass required. Drive-in gravel canyon road; a 23-ft rig fits the larger drive-in spots. RV Life 0 star (unrated) / $. --Claude
note: City of Rifle park, not the neighbouring Rifle Falls State Park, in a limestone canyon along East Rifle Creek, reached by a gravel road past the fish hatchery at the end of Highway 325, with over 250 bolted climbing routes.  Its primitive campsites are first come, first served or reserved online, the 14 Huffman Gulch sites staying first come, first served; sites marked Van take no trailers, and every vehicle must show a day or annual pass.  A 23-ft rig fits the larger drive-in sites. --Claude

note: Dowley family campground at 16 Kenolie Campground, Newfane, open April 10 to October 25 in 2026, with water and 30- or 50-amp electric at its RV sites, room for RVs and trailers up to 40 ft, wooded and open sites, and seasonal and monthly rentals; tent sites and the one lean-to take stays of up to 14 days.
